resources.string: Import a bank CSV and compare it with your expenses and income. The file is read on your phone, without Gemini or bank access. Recorded transactions sync to your existing Sheets workbook.
Use an alias to identify this account for all its imports. No IBAN or credentials are needed.
Negative amounts are expenses and positive amounts are income. If your bank uses another convention, reverse the sign or select debit and credit columns.
Exclude invalid rows from this import
This step does not change your balance. You can then link or record transactions.
Only transactions without matches or signs of transfers, refunds or card settlements will be recorded. Others will remain for comparison. Check the statement dates, signs and currencies first.
An equal amount does not prove this is the same transaction. Compare merchant, date and reference before linking. Linking preserves all existing document details.

A transfer between your own accounts is neither an expense nor income. Refunds, instalments and settlements require review: they are not automatically offset against the original purchase. You can leave them unrecorded while checking.
This is a transfer between my accounts
The linked transaction was deleted. It will not be recreated automatically.
Select an ID only if the bank guarantees it identifies one transaction and remains the same across statements. Do not use a description, card number or reused reference.
Invalid date. Check the selected format.
Invalid amount. Check decimals, grouping, signs and columns.
Check the columns: date, description and amount must be distinct and present.
The CSV must contain at most 5 MiB and 10,000 transactions.
The currency must be a valid code, such as EUR.
Select an account or use a new valid alias.
Review invalid rows or explicitly exclude them.
The same bank ID has different data. Check the ID column; this statement was not saved.
The transaction changed or is already linked. Review the updated data.
Cannot read the CSV. Use a file with a header and comma, semicolon or tab separators.
The operation could not be completed. Saved transactions are preserved; you can retry.
This file was already imported with different settings. Open its saved statement or correct the CSV before importing it again; its transactions have not changed.
Starts at 1. Rows above the header are not imported.
Changing the format detects columns again. Check their mapping before continuing.
You can correct the saved columns, signs and dates. To change the separator or header, select the original CSV: if it matches this file and account, the same statement is preserved.
This reference is the invoice or document number
Enable only if this column contains the actual document number. Automatic linking also requires matching amount, currency, date and merchant. A generic bank reference is not an invoice number.
Protected rows retain their information and links. Edited transactions and existing documents are not overwritten.
%1$d transactions created from this statement that remain unchanged and have no document will be undone. Their rows will return to comparison with the corrected data.
Correcting a statement does not record new transactions. Review pending rows afterwards before adding them to your balance.

The expense or income created from this row will be deleted. This is allowed only if it remains unchanged and has no attached document. The statement row stays marked as undone and will not be recreated automatically.
The previous transaction was deleted. This action returns the row to pending comparison; it does not create another expense or income. Check whether it was recorded elsewhere before deciding.
Operation stopped. Confirmed transactions are preserved; you can continue with pending rows.
The source for this statement is no longer available. Select the original CSV again to correct its settings without creating another statement.
